result.title: Duopra: From Full-Duplex Conversation to Full-Duplex Agency
result.summary: Full-duplex interaction models exhibit strong conversational agency, enabling natural, low-latency turn-taking, backchannels, and interruptions. However, completing tasks further requires task agency: timely tool invocation and argument revision following user corrections. Frontend-backend agents separate initiation from execution: the frontend decides whether and what to request, while the backend determines how. Execution can be offloaded, but unsent requests cannot be executed, and incomplete ones can misdirect the backend. On Full-Duplex-Bench v3 (FDB v3), most failures of Realtime-Venus-Audio + Harness in our streaming pipeline occur before a domain tool executes. We introduce Duopra, a full-duplex interaction model that learns task execution alongside conversational control. Duopra treats the backend as a tool, accepting a self-contained natural-language request. Direct calls and backend delegation share an action interface and requirements for faithful initiation and correct execution. Its three-stage training combines protocol SFT, full-duplex RL rewarding timely and complete execution, and projector-only repair of talker conditioning after thinker updates. With the same backend, Pass@1 rises from 4.7% to 44.7%; Duopra achieves 47.7% calling tools directly (26.0% after SFT) and 49.3% with a DeepSeek backend. It improves three FDB v1.0 takeover rates over the base model. These results show that task agency can coexist with key conversational agency.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Duopra，一个全双工语音交互模型，在对话控制之外同时学习任务执行：把后端当作工具并接受自包含自然语言请求，通过协议 SFT、奖励及时与完整执行的全双工 RL，以及 thinker 更新后仅修 projector 的三阶段训练，提升 FDB v3 上的工具调用成功率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「何时发起请求、请求是否自包含完整」的判定与第三阶段的 projector-only 修复，可能映射到 LVR 中的停止/证据获取决策与思考-读出模块间的贡献分配，但语音全双工场景与视觉推理差异较大，线索需核查。
